message.content: {"needs_revision": true, "reasoning": "The code uses StratifiedKFold on the full training set to build OOF stacking features and bagged models, which is acceptable since it only uses training rows. However, the meta-learner is trained on OOF predictions from models that were themselves trained on folds including the meta-training rows' neighbors, which is standard stacking and not leakage of validation/test labels. The real issue is that CatBoost's categorical feature indices are computed from X.columns order, but after build_features the cat_cols are converted to ints, and CatBoost receives integer-coded categoricals with cat_features indices — this works but the categorical encoding is fit on training data only, which is correct. No validation/test labels are used. The main correctness concern is that the contract requires output prediction as an ORIGINAL label; idx_to_class stores values as JSON (ints become strings via str(k) keys but values preserved), and predict converts back — this is fine. No P0 leakage or P1 critical bug found; code appears correct.", "revised_code": null}
